Sinistra, Lat. Destra) and legend. Unpublished afterwards; notifications with ref=<cid> deleted. Mobile 390px: tools stacked under canvas (canvas y=273.5 < tools y=844), canvas touch-action=none for tablet pointer handling. All data-testids match review spec.
critical_code_review_comments: bodychart.py: AES-256-GCM encryption via seal_fields for markers/strokes/snapshot verified at DB level (enc:v1: prefix). Good.

BodyCanvas.jsx: uses pointer events + setPointerCapture + touchAction:none - correctly supports touch devices without default scroll/zoom interference. picked ref prevents accidental marker creation when tapping existing pin. Correct.
BodychartEditor.jsx: undo stack capped at 50 entries (slice(-49)). Reasonable.
report_payload() correctly returns None unless include_in_report (or force) is set - matches 'only in PDF when ticked' spec.
portal_chart() requires c.report_sent_at OR c.portal_published - correct gating; parent gets 404 pre-publish and post-unpublish (verified both ways).
Minor: Mobile 390px view-tab bar scrolls horizontally (overflow-x-auto) so Lat. destra is reachable by scroll. Could add scroll indicator, but not blocking.
